segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: Clinical-stage company developing oncolytic viral immunotherapies for patients with aggressive and difficult-to-treat cancer tumor types.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one reportable and operating as a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company.

revenueModel.text: Newsoara pays the company upfront, milestone and royalty payments for an exclusive license to develop and commercialize Olvi-Vec in China.
revenueModel.evidence: Newsoara is obligated to pay the Company additional development and commercial milestone payments up to $ 160.5 million in the aggregate upon the occurrence of certain development, regulatory and commercial milestones by the licensed products, and royalties on net sales of the licensed products in the mid-single-digit to mid-teens percentage range (the "Newsoara Royalty").
